afterShellExecution.prompt:
A git commit was just made. Run all four steps below in order. Do not skip any step.

---

## Step 1 — Code Review

Run `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD` and `git log -1 --format='%H %s'`.
Check each changed file against these project conventions:
1. TypeScript strict — no `any`, no `@ts-ignore` without an explanatory comment
2. i18n — zero hardcoded UI strings in JSX or actions; every visible text via dict keys in both en.json and he.json
3. Server actions — Zod validates all FormData before touching the DB; logAuditEvent() on every state-changing action
4. Session guards — use requireTenantAccessBySlug / requireTenantAdminBySlug (old cookie-based guard no longer exists)
5. Supabase env — no top-level process.env; use getPublicSupabaseEnv() / getServerSupabaseEnv() from @/lib/supabase/env
6. RLS awareness — never use the admin client where a user-scoped client is sufficient
7. CLAUDE.md — if routes, guards, dict namespaces, or action signatures changed, the relevant CLAUDE.md was updated
Output each violation as a bullet with file and line. If clean: ✓ Code review passed.

---

## Step 2 — Run Tests

Run `npm run test:unit` in the project root.
Report the result: how many tests passed/failed. If any test fails, list the failing test names and errors.
If all pass: ✓ All unit tests passed.

---

## Step 3 — Update README if needed

Read README.md. Based on the committed diff, check if any of these sections are now stale: Routes table, Stack table, Setup steps, Testing commands.
If stale, update the README to reflect the current state of the project.
If no changes needed: ✓ README is up to date.

---

## Step 4 — Update Notion

Open the Notion page "Project Overview" under Projects > CPA (page id: 35f7620c-e401-81ad-9846-d3a1e9c27d58).
Based on the committed diff, update any stale sections: route map, tech stack, auth flow, DB schema, conventions, or roadmap checklist.
Also update the "Environment Variables" page (id: 35f7620c-e401-815a-aa5f-d4e9c0776f35) if any env vars changed.
If no changes needed: ✓ Notion is up to date.

---

After completing all four steps, print a summary:
✅ Post-commit checklist complete
- Code review: <passed / N violations>
- Tests: <passed / failed>
- README: <updated / up to date>
- Notion: <updated / up to date>

stop.prompt: Review the files that were edited this turn. If any source files under src/ were changed in a way that affects: route structure, session guard names/signatures, i18n dict namespaces, server action patterns, or test helper APIs — and if the relevant CLAUDE.md file(s) were NOT updated this turn — output a brief followup_message reminding the agent to update them now. Otherwise output an empty followup_message.
